title_vi: Câu bị động (2) và have something done
theory_html:
A. Exercises in this group

A. Các bài tập trong nhóm

Exercise 109: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence. Do not use by unless it is important to the meaning.

Bài 109: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa tương tự câu đầu. Không dùng by trừ khi nó quan trọng cho nghĩa.

Exercise 110: Put the verbs into the most suitable passive tense.

Bài 110: Chia động từ ở thì bị động phù hợp nhất.

Exercise 111: Complete the sentences with the correct form of get where possible and a form of be in the others.

Bài 111: Hoàn thành câu với dạng đúng của get khi có thể và một dạng của be ở các câu còn lại.

Exercise 112: Complete the second sentence so that it has a similar meaning to the first sentence.

Bài 112: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa tương tự câu đầu.

Exercise 113: Look at these notes made by a journalist. Then complete the article she wrote for her blog. Use verbs in the correct passive form.

Bài 113: Xem ghi chép của một nhà báo. Rồi hoàn thành bài cô viết cho blog. Dùng động từ ở dạng bị động đúng.

Exercise 114: Tanya wants to rent a flat, but it needs some work before she can move in. Complete the conversation using have and the verbs in brackets.

Bài 114: Tanya muốn thuê căn hộ nhưng nó cần sửa sang trước khi cô dọn vào. Hoàn thành đoạn hội thoại dùng have và động từ trong ngoặc.

Exercise 115: Rewrite the underlined words using have something done.

Bài 115: Viết lại phần gạch chân dùng have something done.

B. Related units

B. Các unit liên quan

English Grammar in Use, Units 42–46 (theory below).

English Grammar in Use, Unit 42–46 (lý thuyết bên dưới).

mcq.question: (The instructor has marked all the assignments.) All the assignments ___.
mcq.full: (The instructor has marked all the assignments.) All the assignments have been marked.
mcq.vi: (Giảng viên đã chấm tất cả bài tập.) Tất cả bài tập đã được chấm.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have been + V3.
mcq.key: (The instructor has marked all the assignments.) All the assignments ___.|have been marked

mcq.question: (My hairdresser kept me waiting for half an hour.) I ___ waiting for half an hour by my hairdresser.
mcq.full: (My hairdresser kept me waiting for half an hour.) I was kept waiting for half an hour by my hairdresser.
mcq.vi: (Thợ làm tóc bắt tôi chờ nửa tiếng.) Tôi bị bắt chờ nửa tiếng bởi thợ làm tóc.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3.
mcq.key: (My hairdresser kept me waiting for half an hour.) I ___ waiting for half an hour by my hairdresser.|was kept

mcq.question: (The students must pay their own fees for this course.) The fees for this course ___ by the students.
mcq.full: (The students must pay their own fees for this course.) The fees for this course must be paid by the students.
mcq.vi: (Sinh viên phải tự đóng học phí khóa này.) Học phí khóa này phải được đóng bởi sinh viên.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: modal + be + V3.
mcq.key: (The students must pay their own fees for this course.) The fees for this course ___ by the students.|must be paid

mcq.question: (Do you suppose your brother could have sent that text?) Do you suppose that text ___ by your brother?
mcq.full: (Do you suppose your brother could have sent that text?) Do you suppose that text could have been sent by your brother?
mcq.vi: (Bạn có nghĩ anh bạn có thể đã gửi tin nhắn đó không?) Bạn có nghĩ tin nhắn đó có thể đã được gửi bởi anh bạn không?
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: could have been + V3.
mcq.key: (Do you suppose your brother could have sent that text?) Do you suppose that text ___ by your brother?|could have been sent

mcq.question: (Solar panels supply all the power for this house.) All the power for this house ___ by solar panels.
mcq.full: (Solar panels supply all the power for this house.) All the power for this house is supplied by solar panels.
mcq.vi: (Pin mặt trời cung cấp toàn bộ điện cho ngôi nhà.) Toàn bộ điện của ngôi nhà được cung cấp bởi pin mặt trời.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: is + V3.
mcq.key: (Solar panels supply all the power for this house.) All the power for this house ___ by solar panels.|is supplied

mcq.question: (Nobody informed the police that there had been a mistake.) The police ___ that there had been a mistake.
mcq.full: (Nobody informed the police that there had been a mistake.) The police weren’t informed that there had been a mistake.
mcq.vi: (Không ai báo cảnh sát là có sai sót.) Cảnh sát không được thông báo là có sai sót.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: weren’t + V3.
mcq.key: (Nobody informed the police that there had been a mistake.) The police ___ that there had been a mistake.|weren’t informed

mcq.question: (Where will your company post you next year?) Where will you ___ by your company next year?
mcq.full: (Where will your company post you next year?) Where will you be posted by your company next year?
mcq.vi: (Năm sau công ty sẽ cử bạn đi đâu?) Năm sau bạn sẽ được cử đi đâu?
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: will be + V3.
mcq.key: (Where will your company post you next year?) Where will you ___ by your company next year?|be posted

mcq.question: (The news about the war worried Josephine.) Josephine ___ by the news about the war.
mcq.full: (The news about the war worried Josephine.) Josephine was worried by the news about the war.
mcq.vi: (Tin chiến tranh khiến Josephine lo lắng.) Josephine lo lắng vì tin chiến tranh.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3.
mcq.key: (The news about the war worried Josephine.) Josephine ___ by the news about the war.|was worried

mcq.question: (I’ve still got the money because no one has claimed it.) I’ve still got the money because it ___ by anyone.
mcq.full: (I’ve still got the money because no one has claimed it.) I’ve still got the money because it hasn’t been claimed by anyone.
mcq.vi: (Tôi vẫn giữ tiền vì chưa ai đến nhận.) Tôi vẫn giữ tiền vì nó chưa được ai nhận.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: hasn’t been + V3.
mcq.key: (I’ve still got the money because no one has claimed it.) I’ve still got the money because it ___ by anyone.|hasn’t been claimed

mcq.question: (Has anyone ever asked you for your opinion?) Have you ever ___ for your opinion?
mcq.full: (Has anyone ever asked you for your opinion?) Have you ever been asked for your opinion?
mcq.vi: (Đã có ai từng hỏi ý kiến bạn chưa?) Bạn đã bao giờ được hỏi ý kiến chưa?
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: have been + V3.
mcq.key: (Has anyone ever asked you for your opinion?) Have you ever ___ for your opinion?|been asked

mcq.question: (People shouldn’t allow children to watch that kind of TV programme.) Children ___ to watch that kind of TV programme.
mcq.full: (People shouldn’t allow children to watch that kind of TV programme.) Children shouldn’t be allowed to watch that kind of TV programme.
mcq.vi: (Không nên cho trẻ xem loại chương trình đó.) Trẻ em không nên được phép xem loại chương trình đó.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: shouldn’t be + V3.
mcq.key: (People shouldn’t allow children to watch that kind of TV programme.) Children ___ to watch that kind of TV programme.|shouldn’t be allowed

mcq.question: (All visitors must wear identity badges.) Identity badges ___ by all visitors.
mcq.full: (All visitors must wear identity badges.) Identity badges must be worn by all visitors.
mcq.vi: (Mọi khách phải đeo thẻ.) Thẻ phải được đeo bởi mọi khách.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must be + V3.
mcq.key: (All visitors must wear identity badges.) Identity badges ___ by all visitors.|must be worn

mcq.question: (Someone must have changed the time of the meeting.) The time of the meeting ___.
mcq.full: (Someone must have changed the time of the meeting.) The time of the meeting must have been changed.
mcq.vi: (Hẳn ai đó đã đổi giờ họp.) Giờ họp hẳn đã bị đổi.
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: must have been + V3.
mcq.key: (Someone must have changed the time of the meeting.) The time of the meeting ___.|must have been changed

mcq.question: (When will someone deliver the food for the party?) When ___ the food for the party ___?
mcq.full: (When will someone deliver the food for the party?) When will the food for the party be delivered?
mcq.vi: (Khi nào người ta giao đồ ăn cho bữa tiệc?) Khi nào đồ ăn cho bữa tiệc sẽ được giao?
mcq.expl:
Active → passive: keep the tense / modal and use be + past participle (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); use by only when the agent is important.
Chủ động → bị động: giữ thì / động từ khuyết thiếu và dùng be + quá khứ phân từ (must be paid, could have been sent, hasn’t been claimed); chỉ dùng by khi tác nhân quan trọng.
Điểm ngữ pháp: will + S + be + V3.
mcq.key: (When will someone deliver the food for the party?) When ___ the food for the party ___?|will … be delivered

mcq.question: I left my phone at home and I came on the bus. Then ___ in a traffic jam for forty minutes.
mcq.full: I left my phone at home and I came on the bus. Then the bus was stuck in a traffic jam for forty minutes.
mcq.vi: Mình để quên điện thoại ở nhà và đi xe buýt. Rồi xe buýt bị kẹt xe bốn mươi phút.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: was + V3.
mcq.key: I left my phone at home and I came on the bus. Then ___ in a traffic jam for forty minutes.|the bus was stuck

mcq.question: Why didn’t you just walk across the park as usual? – Because the park ___ since last weekend.
mcq.full: Why didn’t you just walk across the park as usual? – Because the park has been closed since last weekend.
mcq.vi: Sao bạn không đi bộ qua công viên như mọi khi? – Vì công viên bị đóng cửa từ cuối tuần trước.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: since → has been + V3.
mcq.key: Why didn’t you just walk across the park as usual? – Because the park ___ since last weekend.|has been closed

mcq.question: Why’s that? – A celebrity tennis tournament ___ there.
mcq.full: Why’s that? – A celebrity tennis tournament is being held there.
mcq.vi: Sao vậy? – Một giải quần vợt người nổi tiếng đang được tổ chức ở đó.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Đang diễn ra → is being + V3.
mcq.key: Why’s that? – A celebrity tennis tournament ___ there.|is being held

mcq.question: My friend said ___ here in a private plane by the organisers.
mcq.full: My friend said they were flown here in a private plane by the organisers.
mcq.vi: Bạn mình nói họ được chở bằng máy bay riêng đến đây bởi ban tổ chức.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: were + V3.
mcq.key: My friend said ___ here in a private plane by the organisers.|they were flown

mcq.question: If they’re there, the hotel ___ by fans and security guards.
mcq.full: If they’re there, the hotel will be surrounded by fans and security guards.
mcq.vi: Nếu họ ở đó, khách sạn sẽ bị vây kín bởi người hâm mộ và bảo vệ.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: will be + V3.
mcq.key: If they’re there, the hotel ___ by fans and security guards.|will be surrounded

mcq.question: They won’t go to our local disco. And ___ to their suite.
mcq.full: They won’t go to our local disco. And we won’t be invited to their suite.
mcq.vi: Họ sẽ không đến vũ trường địa phương đâu. Và chúng ta sẽ không được mời đến phòng họ.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: won’t be + V3.
mcq.key: They won’t go to our local disco. And ___ to their suite.|we won’t be invited

mcq.question: In fact, the disco ___ if the hotel is full of celebrities.
mcq.full: In fact, the disco will probably be cancelled if the hotel is full of celebrities.
mcq.vi: Thực ra, buổi disco có lẽ sẽ bị hủy nếu khách sạn đầy người nổi tiếng.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: will probably be + V3.
mcq.key: In fact, the disco ___ if the hotel is full of celebrities.|will probably be cancelled

mcq.question: Perhaps ___ to sell programmes or something.
mcq.full: Perhaps we’ll be employed to sell programmes or something.
mcq.vi: Có lẽ chúng ta sẽ được thuê bán tờ chương trình hay gì đó.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: will be + V3.
mcq.key: Perhaps ___ to sell programmes or something.|we’ll be employed

mcq.question: OK, if you want to. But don’t expect ___ anywhere near the big stars.
mcq.full: OK, if you want to. But don’t expect to be allowed anywhere near the big stars.
mcq.vi: Được thôi nếu bạn muốn. Nhưng đừng mong được phép lại gần các ngôi sao lớn.
mcq.expl:
Choose the passive tense from the time reference: has been done (since), is being done (now), was done / had been done (past), will be done / is going to be done (future), to be done (infinitive).
Chọn thì bị động theo mốc thời gian: has been done (since), is being done (bây giờ), was done / had been done (quá khứ), will be done / is going to be done (tương lai), to be done (nguyên mẫu).
Điểm ngữ pháp: expect + to be + V3.
mcq.key: OK, if you want to. But don’t expect ___ anywhere near the big stars.|to be allowed

mcq.question: I never found that book we were looking for. It ___ lost when we moved house.
mcq.full: I never found that book we were looking for. It got lost when we moved house.
mcq.vi: Tôi chẳng bao giờ tìm thấy cuốn sách đó. Nó bị thất lạc khi chuyển nhà.
mcq.expl:
get + past participle for things that happen (get lost, get cut off, get promoted); be (not get) for states and verbs like believe, respect, suppose.
get + quá khứ phân từ cho sự việc xảy ra (get lost, get cut off, get promoted); dùng be (không dùng get) cho trạng thái và động từ như believe, respect, suppose.
Điểm ngữ pháp: get lost.
mcq.key: I never found that book we were looking for. It ___ lost when we moved house.|got

mcq.question: After the way he behaved last time, it’s unlikely he ___ asked there again.
mcq.full: After the way he behaved last time, it’s unlikely he’ll get asked there again.
mcq.vi: Sau cách cư xử lần trước, khó mà anh ta lại được mời đến đó.
